specifications.title: Discriminate documented F exceptions, clock consumption, direction and page continuity
specifications.status_at_registration: preregistered before real source candidate execution
specifications.rationale: Attempt1 produced no frequency-alignment leads for its registered no-skip prime clock branches. Known LP1 DIVINITY and LP2/56 offer exact reference tests of exception semantics before extending any unknown-page hypothesis.
specifications.preexecution_correction: Before any real source candidate execution, the Attempt1 rationale wording was corrected to describe absence of frequency leads rather than exact exclusion; all H001 criteria, parameters and budget are unchanged.
specifications.scope: Known-page mechanism discrimination only; no new unsolved-page candidates, no dictionary or skip-mask search.

arithmetic.domain: rune ordinal indices 0..28, not GP prime values or Latin letters
arithmetic.key_source_wording: reverse Vigenere cipher; key divinity; continuous chunk adding to end of page 3
arithmetic.direction_interpretation: Primary interpretation is P=(C-K[t mod8]) mod29; source phrase does not alone establish algebraic direction, so P=(C+K[t mod8]) mod29 is a fixed comparison.
arithmetic.prime_delta: prime[t]-1 with zero-based t, prime[0]=2; offset=0 and shift=1
arithmetic.literals: Every non-rune codepoint is preserved and consumes no clock in H001.
arithmetic.page_reset: Reset only key clock to zero before each page; skip coordinates remain global rune ordinals.
arithmetic.step_clock: clock_index is the clock before handling the rune; delta is zero at every selected skip; consumed records actual advancement.

LP1_combined.input: Exact sentence in source04 Tool block; 638 codepoints and 515 runes; source03 singleline plus one ASCII space plus source04 singleline.
LP1_combined.coordinate_system: One-based Unicode codepoints, including ASCII spaces; all selected glyphs must be F before running.

LP2_56.coordinate_system: Zero-based Unicode codepoint in stripped source73 singleline, including hash and spaces; distinct from source03/04 convention.

policies.none: Transform every rune and advance clock once per rune.
policies.specified_free: Keep source-selected exceptions unchanged and do not advance clock there.
policies.specified_consume: Keep source-selected exceptions unchanged but advance clock there.
policies.all_cipher_f_free: Keep every input ciphertext index0 unchanged and do not advance clock there.

acceptance.primary: Subtract + specified_free + continuous must equal independently constructed expected sequence on every rune of each applicable page.
acceptance.all_configurations: Record exact equality, count and first mismatch, all step arithmetic, preserved literal layout, and independent forward reconstruction using each frozen delta/mask. Do not reconstruct inverse by reselecting F from decrypted output.
acceptance.comparisons: No comparison is prelabelled negative; equivalent transformations may coincide and must be reported as such.
acceptance.expected_source: Use Plaintext sections with bracket alternatives and unique segmentation by cipher word rune counts. Never cleaned plaintext, LLM reconstruction, spelling correction or transform output.
acceptance.diagnostic_if_primary_exact: Compare independently expected plaintext index0 positions with prescribed skip set and independently encrypt expected runes using plaintext-F-driven free skips. Report mask equality and exact ciphertext reconstruction per source/page; do not generalize to all unknown pages.
acceptance.statistics: Exact reference comparison only; no language scoring or statistical significance selected from these configurations.
acceptance.outcomes: passed, negative, error, timeout and inconclusive remain distinct. Failure excludes only the tested parameters, source and criterion.

limits: Independent computation path is not independent historical provenance; source repositories may share ancestry.
Original image viewing confirms layout, not an independent person-by-person glyph audit.
A recovered known page is a regression result, not a new Liber Primus solution.
No learned exception-mask selector for unknown ciphertext is established by this test.

specifications.registration_phase: Before new real-source candidate computation; existing H000 known-answer baseline already public
specifications.hypothesis: On the known LP2/56 page, the prime-minus-one clock spans line, title/body and literal hash boundaries while consuming only non-exception runes.

parameters.formula: P=(C-(prime[t]-1)) mod29; first prime at t=0 is 2
parameters.skip_semantics: Copy rune ordinal 56 unchanged and do not advance clock; fixed during inverse encryption too
parameters.title_basis: Five red title runes at ordinals 0..4; first master clause marker at source_offset 7; image and source Red Text agree. Reset before source_offset 8 / rune ordinal 5, not after a whole visual line.
parameters.semicolon_interpretation: Included explicitly in delimiter-consume branch as a tested convention; its source delimiter meaning remains unresolved
parameters.formatting_semantics: All whitespace ignored by clock; every non-rune preserved byte-for-byte in UTF-8 output

branches.rule: Initialize t=0 once; only non-skipped runes advance
Reset t=0 after each raw slash; effective next-rune reset ordinals 20,39,45,67; keep repeated hash-line events
Reset t=0 after each raw ampersand; offsets65 and205 both precede the next rune45, so boundary events are observationally redundant
Reset t=0 once, immediately before source_offset8
Continuous plus one extra advance for each ASCII hex character within the five fixed hash spans; preserve those characters
Continuous plus one extra advance for each raw character in the fixed punctuation set; ignore hash literals and whitespace

parameters.cross_page_continuity: Not tested; one known page only

specifications.scorer: None; exact reference rune comparison only
specifications.success: Per branch: all85 reference runes agree, non-runes remain unchanged, independent arithmetic trace agrees, and inverse encryption with the same frozen skip/clock convention returns the exact original raw text
specifications.failure: A completed branch with reference mismatches is negative only for this input and fixed convention; save total mismatches and first mismatch ordinal/source offset. Exceptions are error, timeouts are timeout, insufficient verification is inconclusive.
specifications.expectation_source: Existing reference_indices built from the source Plaintext Latin alternatives and ciphertext word rune counts, never Cleaned up Plaintext; reference construction must remain outside the candidate transform module
specifications.independence_limits: Key recipe, skip and known plaintext share ibot73.md. Arithmetic and reference algorithms can be independent; neither cross-repository rune equality nor this audit proves historical source independence.
aliases: continuous aliases H001 documented skip/no-consume and existing H000 baseline; do not count as independent discovery
Repeated resets without an intervening consuming event have the same next-rune effect; retain event trace without double-counting evidence

coverage.all_unsolved_pages: Not eligible for known-answer exact audit; no claimed new coverage
coverage.other_known_pages: Excluded because this hypothesis is specific to the LP2/56 prime stream and its hash/title boundaries

controls: Hand-computed tiny-input unit tests before real-source execution
Independent exact-rune/reference and arithmetic checks after execution
specifications.statistical_claims: No language scoring, p-values, multiple-testing significance or generalization to unsolved pages
